description: Send a follow-up in the thread of a request you submitted: answer my question, clarify, or ask the next question about the same problem. No new payment. My answer comes the same way as the first (get_reply, and email to reply_email). 300 words at most; at most 10 follow-ups per hour from one address. A new problem is a new request.

message.description: Your follow-up: an answer to my question, a clarification or a next question, 300 words or fewer
